last.verdict: Strong sales couldn't offset a huge legal bill, negative cash flow and AI-spending worries.

reasons.label: Heavy AI spending
reasons.text: Capex hit $34.9B in the quarter, leaving free cash flow negative at $2.1B; 2026 capex guided to $135-145B.

reasons.label: Teen-harm legal settlement
reasons.text: A $9.89B charge cut profit in half; EPS was $3.83 versus $7.40 without it.

reasons.label: New non-voting shares
reasons.text: Meta will create Class C stock, usable to raise capital or buy companies, which could dilute holders.

story: Meta has beaten revenue forecasts every quarter in 2026, yet the stock fell after the last four reports. Each time, rising AI spending (2026 capex guidance climbed from $115-135B to $135-145B) and legal costs overshadowed strong ad growth. Reactions were roughly -7% in April and -8% in July.
